caption: A finger tips over the first domino in a long row standing on a table, and the whole row falls one after another.

sa.check: A long row of dominoes stands on a table.
A finger tips over the first domino.
The whole row falls one after another.
Only the first domino is touched by the finger.
The finger's push comes first and the rest fall in turn.

pc.expect: Each domino starts to fall only after the one before it strikes it.
pc.fail: A domino falls before the one behind it reaches it; or a domino is struck and stays standing while the wave carries on past it; or dominoes further down the row fall while the ones before them still stand.

pc.expect: The wave runs steadily from the pushed end toward the far end and does not turn back; fallen dominoes stay down.
pc.fail: The wave reverses and runs back up the row; or a fallen domino stands itself up again; or the row falls from the far end back toward the finger.

pc.expect: Each domino topples the way the wave is travelling, landing on the next one or on the table.
pc.fail: A domino topples backward against the wave; or one is flung clear off the table by the touch of its neighbour; or one spins on the spot instead of toppling.

pc.expect: The dominoes stay rigid tiles that clack and slide a little, and the table stays flat under them.
pc.fail: A domino bends as it falls; or a domino bounces high off the table; or the table surface ripples as the wave passes along it.

pc.expect: The dominoes keep their number and stay on top of the table.
pc.fail: A domino vanishes as it falls or a new one appears in the row; or a domino passes through the one beside it; or a domino sinks into the table.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The dominoes' colour and spots, the table and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: A domino changes colour or its spots as it falls; or the table's surface changes pattern between frames; or the room behind rearranges.

note: The finger is kept as the minimal trigger for the first domino; the hand behind it is not judged.
